name: BurnsBuild burnToHolder credits burns at the spot pair price
summary: BurnsBuild.burnToHolder prices the burned Burns tokens with router.getAmountsOut over the Burns/WBNB pair's spot reserves, pulls that much BNB from the Burns token contract and credits the caller reward shares worth it, which receiveRewards pays out in BNB. With flash-loaned USDT the attacker bought Burns to inflate its pair price, burned 34,275 and 246,430 Burns for 334.46 BNB of credit, and withdrew 311.62 BNB in the same transaction.
notes: The reset is the owner's setMainToken(Burns) on BurnsBuild, which set the token whose pair prices burns and whose BNB pays for them, 951 blocks after deployment and after the token's setburnsHolder grant to BurnsBuild; setLaunch only opened trading.

Of the 13,620 burns since deployment, only three transactions reached burnToHolder through a contract: the anchor and two small copycats in the campaign (0xbce323d0 with 40 burns in October 2024, 0x661c21ca in October 2026). All other burns were sent directly by EOAs at the prevailing pair price, and the eight before the anchor credited at most 1.25 BNB each.

Loss is the net BNB depletion of the Burns token contract and BurnsBuild, which together hold holders' reward funds; BurnsBuild kept part of what it pulled from the token within the anchor. Burns tokens are unpriced and not valued.
